name: Sublime Côte d'Ivoire
aliases: Sublime Côte d'Ivoire (Ministère du Tourisme et des Loisirs)
note: Sublime Côte d'Ivoire is the tourism brand of the Côte d'Ivoire Ministry of Tourism and Leisure, so the state controls it (sublime-ministry-ownership). Whether Côte d'Ivoire has a sourced record of serious abuses hasn't been researched yet; if it has, state control makes this a Serious rating under METHOD.md. The brand's own site (mysublimecotedivoire.com) was unreachable (TLS error), so the ownership rests on press coverage of the OM partnership naming the ministry.
